No visible sidewalks, curb ramps, or pedestrian refuge areas on the bridge segment; this limits barrier-free accessibility for non-drivers and reduces overall accessibility across user groups.

Noise and visual dominance of heavy traffic infrastructure (multiple lanes, barriers, overhead gantries) reduce perceived neighborhood pleasantness for anyone near or under the structure.

No visible dedicated bus lane, transit stop, or rail infrastructure on the corridor segment to support low-carbon mass transit use.
